# Nuvix

Nuvix is a Malaysia-based digital business solutions provider operated by Nuvix Int Enterprise.

## Main services
- Website design and development
- Custom web applications and internal business systems
- NuCard digital business cards with QR and NFC-ready profiles
- Business workflow automation
- SEO and Google Ads support
- Brand and graphic design
- Printing and marketing materials
- Website maintenance and technical support

## Service area
Malaysia.
